caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## Application
- **Application Name**: LibreOffice Writer
- **Operating System**: Ubuntu (visible from the sidebar icons and theme)
- **File Name**: "04 CHIN9505 EBook Purchasing Info 2021 Jan.docx"
- **Time and Date**: Displayed in the top-right corner as "Mar 22 04:31".

---

## Top Menu Bar
- **Menu Options**:
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help
- **Active Toolbar**:
  - Contains icons for common actions such as saving, undo, redo, formatting, and alignment.
  - Includes font selection dropdown (set to "Calibri") and font size dropdown (set to "12 pt").
  - Text formatting options such as bold, italic, underline, font color, and background color.
  - Paragraph alignment options (left, center, right, justify).
  - Line spacing and bullet/numbered list options.

---

## Document Area
- **Document Content**:
  - Text content is displayed with some spelling errors underlined in red.
  - Example text includes instructions for purchasing and using an eBook.
  - Text formatting includes bold and normal text.
  - Some words are highlighted in red, indicating spelling or grammar issues.

---

## Notifications
- **Blue Notification Bars**:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Includes buttons: "Get involved" and "Donate".
  - Each notification has a close button (X) on the right.

---

## Sidebar
- **Visible Sidebar Icons**:
  - **Top to Bottom**:
    - Activities (Ubuntu logo)
    - Visual Studio Code
    - LibreOffice Writer (active application)
    - VLC Media Player
    - File Manager
    - Firefox Browser
    - Help
    - Trash Bin

---

## Status Bar
- **Bottom Status Bar**:
  - Displays "Page 1 of 1".
  - Shows word and character count: "73 words, 431 characters".
  - Indicates the current page style: "Default Page Style".
  - Language setting: "English (USA)".
  - Zoom level: "173%".

---

## Additional Features
- **Ruler**:
  - Horizontal ruler visible at the top of the document area.
  - Used for adjusting margins and tab stops.
